profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | AWS Solutions Architect
profile.summary: I am a seasoned backend software engineer who enjoys designing enterprise scale serverless workflows, deploying cloud infrastructure, and building robust secure APIs. I have expertise in multiple software languages and database platforms. I enjoy creating solution architectures that translate product vision into cost effective technical requirements and meet the needs of the most demanding data pipelines. In my current role I lead an agile scrum team responsible for developing and maintaining automotive digital marketing products. Adjectives used by peers to describe my leadership skills: innovative, dedicated, empathic, direct, and passionate. Appreciative inquiry guides the process I use to develop exceptional team cohesion and business relationships.
